project.title: Db2 Error Doctor
project.short_description: Paste a Db2 error and get its cause and fix: exact SQLCODE lookup first, Db2 vector search through LangChain when the message has no code.

ibm_db2.edition: Db2 Community Edition (Docker, via the IBM Db2 Developer Extension for VS Code)
features_used: VECTOR column and VECTOR_DISTANCE cosine search
Relational tables with primary key and identity column
Index and GROUP BY / JOIN analytics
